## Checklist

- [ ] No `any` types, explicit return types, JSDoc on public APIs (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/noorixorg/nauth-toolkit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in the docs (`nauth-docs/`) and `CHANGELOG.md`
